The '''Flash Star''', added in [[Update Log|Update 14]], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (8th Season).

As of 19/08/23, the day of [[Update Log|Update 16]], and the end of Season 8, the Flash Star could be opened to receive [[Minata]].
